article.headline: Banks scores 16 as Georgia Southern takes down Southern Miss 78-64 in Sun Belt Conference Tournament
article.description: — Eren Banks had 16 points in Georgia Southern's 78-64 victory over Southern Miss on Wednesday in the Sun Belt Conference Tournament's second round.
article.linkText: Banks scores 16 as Georgia Southern takes down Southern Miss 78-64 in Sun Belt Conference Tournament
article.story: PENSACOLA, Fla. -- — Eren Banks had 16 points in Georgia Southern's 78-64 victory over Southern Miss on Wednesday in the Sun Belt Conference Tournament's second round. Ninth-seeded Georgia Southern advances to play No. 8 seed Georgia State in Thursday's third round. Banks shot 6 for 11 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line for the Eagles (17-15). Tyson Brown scored 14 points while shooting 7 of 10 from the field and added 12 rebounds. Bradley Douglas shot 5 for 11 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points, while adding seven rebounds. Denijay Harris led the way for the 12-seed Golden Eagles (11-22) with 14 points and two steals. Alfred Worrell Jr. added 12 points and two steals for Southern Miss. Christian Watson had 11 points. The loss was the Golden Eagles' eighth in a row. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
